description: This file acts as an index or export aggregator for various cryptographic modules and utilities within the 'crypto-runtime' component of the project. It exports classes, types, and functions related to cryptography, verification, persistence, and device management.

classes.name: MatrixCryptoBootstrapper
classes.description: Handles the initialization and bootstrap process for matrix cryptography.

classes.name: MatrixVerificationManager
classes.description: Manages device verification processes and statuses.

methods.name: createMatrixCryptoFacade
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the cryptography facade for matrix encryption/decryption.

methods.name: persistIdbToDisk
methods.description: Persists IndexedDB data to disk for durability.

methods.name: isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Checks whether the device owner has been verified.
